title: Bring the health ideas together

visuals.title: Connect barriers, response and memory
visuals.caption: Skin and mucous membranes help prevent entry. Inflammation is an innate response. Specific recognition and immune memory belong to adaptive immunity; memory is not a separate fourth defence line.
